10oudsz:212: The Wukong AI recruitment case provides the most authentic record of the transition "from broken to working". The first-generation all-purpose Agent (600+ lines of Prompt + 13 tools) ran for a week and every problem surfaced—high tool-selection error rate, chaotic context, no state persistence, and no debuggability.
